title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - MemoryCapabilities
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/MemoryCapabilities. Describes the memory (RAM) capabilities available in a given service flavor, including any overprovisioning ratio.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MemoryCapabilities'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

memory.description: Relationship. Amount of virtual RAM available in the given flavor. Links to a Memory entity.

overProvisioningRatio.description: Property. Non-negative float (>=1) defining the overprovisioning amount. A value of 1 means no overprovisioning; >1 indicates virtual RAM exceeds physical RAM (e.g. factor 2 = 2x); maximum value is 3.
